description: CAREER Tornado Resiliance Structural Retrofit for Sustainable Housing Communities is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by David Prevatt, University of Florida (ufl.edu). The data.csv files are located in Plywood Tests and OSB Tests folders. Each folder contains 10 test of a wood frame model that is supposed to represent what an actual wall built in practice would be built as. Each specimen was tested to failure. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Wood, Wind Engineering, Fragility Functions. Published 2019-12-24. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
